import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

  const STORAGE_KEY = 'soullink.lang.v1';

  function getInitialLang() {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
      if (saved === 'ru' || saved === 'en') return saved;
    } catch (_) { /* private mode / file origin */ }
    const navigatorLang = (navigator.language || 'en').toLowerCase();
    return navigatorLang.startsWith('ru') ? 'ru' : 'en';
  }

  let lang = getInitialLang();

  function t(key, vars) {
    const table = DICT[lang] || DICT.en;
    let value = table[key];
    if (value == null) value = DICT.en[key];
    if (value == null) value = key;
    if (vars) {
      value = value.replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, function (_, name) {
        return vars[name] != null ? String(vars[name]) : '{' + name + '}';
      });
    }
    return value;
  }

  function apply(root) {
    const scope = root || document;
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(function (el) {
      const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
      if (key) el.textContent = t(key);
    });
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-placeholder]').forEach(function (el) {
      const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-placeholder');
      if (key) el.setAttribute('placeholder', t(key));
    });
    scope.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-title]').forEach(function (el) {
      const key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-title');
      if (key) el.setAttribute('title', t(key));
    });
    document.documentElement.lang = lang;
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-lang', lang);
  }

  function setLang(next) {
    if (next !== 'ru' && next !== 'en') return false;
    if (next === lang) return false;
    lang = next;
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, lang); } catch (_) {}
    apply(document);
    document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('soullink:language', { detail: { lang: lang } }));
    return true;
  }

  window.SL = window.SL || {};
  SL.i18n = {
    t: t,
    apply: apply,
    setLang: setLang,
    get lang() { return lang; },
    get dict() { return DICT; },
    storageKey: STORAGE_KEY
  };
})();

API `SL.audio`:
- init() creates context on first user gesture.
- setVolumes(settings)
- setMuted(bool)
- startMusic(), stopMusic()
- sfx(name)
- unlock() call on first pointerdown/keydown.
- Music scheduler.

We want no audio until interaction. App boot maybe settings load. `audio.init()` called on first user gesture; then `startMusic()` if not muted. Could call from app after first interaction.

Music composition: Original 8-bar loop in D minor. We'll use a simple bassline + arpeggio. WebAudio scheduling lookahead.
- tempo 84 BPM, 8th notes.
- notes frequencies. Use midi->freq.
- sequence per 16 steps:
  bass: D2, D2, A2, F2 maybe 4 bars.
  arp: D4 F4 A4 F4 D4 A3 F4 A3 etc.
  pad: soft triangle every bar.
- Use master gain. Music gain low.
- Music envelope attack 0.01, decay to 0.0001.
- Scheduler setInterval every 100ms; schedule ahead 0.2s. Each step duration 60/bpm/2 (eighth). 32 steps loop.
- Create oscillator + gain per note; connect to musicGain. musicGain -> master.
- Master gain set based settings master/100 * (muted?0:1). Music gain = music/100*0.22; SFX gain = sfx/100*0.55.
- On volume change scheduled.
- SFX:
  - move: square 330->220 0.04s
  - confirm: square 440->660, 0.08
  - back: 330->180
  - pickup: triangle arpeggio 660,880,1320
  - hurt: sawtooth 120->60 0.18 noise? Use oscillator.
  - heal: sine 520->780
  - battle: low pulse
  - error: square 120.
  - install: chime.
- Implement `tone(freq, dur, type, gain, slideTo)`.
- Noise buffer for hurt maybe. Keep.
- Music start/stop with fade.
- Handle context suspended/resume.

Write audio.js.

Now store.js: settings, mods metadata, IndexedDB file storage, theme application, settings UI update helpers maybe later.

API:
```
SL.store = {
 settings, loadSettings, saveSettings, updateSetting
 mods: [],
 loadMods(), saveMods(), addMod, updateMod, removeMod, getActiveMods, getThemeMod, currentPalette
 db: {put,get,delete,clear}
 setThemeMod etc.
 computeStorage()
 applyTheme()
 formatBytes, formatNumber, timeAgo? maybe.
 resetAll()
}
```
Use localStorage key `soullink.mods.v1`. JSON. Mod records contain no Blob; blob in IDB keyed `blobKey` or id.

IndexedDB:
- open on demand; version 1 store `files`.
- In file:// WebView, indexedDB may throw SecurityError; catch and set availability false. For sample theme no file.
- `putFile(id, blob)`, `getFile(id)`, `deleteFile(id)`, `clearFiles()`.
- Could use cache fallback to in-memory Map if IDB unavailable. Implement memoryFiles Map.
- storage use estimate via navigator.storage.estimate if available, else sum metadata sizes.

Settings:
- load from localStorage merged DEFAULT_SETTINGS.
- apply body classes: no-scanlines, reduce-motion, no-pixel-filter, is-muted, lefty.
- expose update.

Theme:
- `getActiveMods`: mods.filter(active && !missing).
- `currentThemeMod`: active mod with latest activatedAt, or demo.
- `paletteForMod(mod)`: if mod.paletteIndex within; else by hash.
- `applyTheme`: root style --mod-accent etc.; body dataset.
- `currentPalette()` returns palette object (default PALETTES[0] or mod palette).
- Theme mixing? If active mods, last active mod. fine.
- `themeName`: mod.name or 'VANILLA'.
- `hasDataWin`.

Persist mods:
- Sort by installDate descending? Keep array. Active order via activatedAt.
- `setActive(id, active)` sets active and activatedAt=Date.now(); if deactivating maybe.
- `addMod(record)` dedupe by id; if duplicate update? `id` generated from hash.
- If a GameBanana mod installed already (same gb id), install new? Use id `gb-<modId>`? To allow updates, use `gb-<id>`; but local data hash maybe. We'll use id `gb-${id}` for GameBanana installs, and `local-${hash}` for files. Reinstall replaces existing record/blob.
- `removeMod(id)` deletes blob if blobId.
- `saveMods` triggers app refresh via `soullink:mods` event.
- `storageBytes` sum size.

`formatBytes`: 0 B, KB, MB, GB. Russian "МБ" maybe? Use latin MB for consistency.

`formatNum`: k. `1.2K`, `7.2K`.

`timeAgo`: not needed.

`hashBlobPrefix(blob, maxBytes)`: crypto.subtle.digest over first 1MB; returns hex. Use `crypto.subtle` only secure context; file:// may not have? WebView file:// might treat as secure? `crypto.subtle` available only secure contexts; file:// is potentially trustworthy in Chrome? Maybe. Fallback simple hash over name+size+timestamp. For palette use string.

`randomId`.

`inspectDataWin(blob)`: read first 12 bytes. Return {valid, form, chunk}.

`derivePaletteIndex(seed)`: hash string to index.

`resetAll`: localStorage remove keys settings/mods/lang? Maybe keep language? Reset all including language? Probably settings/mods and cache, language stays. clear IDB; mods=[]. App refresh.

Input:

- `SL.game.setDirection(dir, pressed)` sets keys.
- `handleAction()`:
  - if mode dialogue: advance typewriter/next line.

  - if battle: no action maybe.

Simpler bounds y>=76; when gateOpen allow y>=50 near gate and completing when y<64. Gate x range 208..272. If gate closed, clamp y>=76. If open and x in gate range, allow y down to 56; if y<68 -> complete. Nice.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build an original Undertale-style launcher web app with mobile pixel controls, community mod support (`data.win`, ZIP, `.xdelta`), an in-game mod browser (main menu: New Game, Settings, Mods) integrated with GameBanana.
- User additionally requested: “И ещё на андроид АПК” — provide an Android APK.

## Requirements
- Main menu must contain exactly: New Game, Settings, Mods.
- Mobile controls in pixel style, usable on Android.
- Mods must support `data.win` or other community formats and be downloadable from GameBanana.
- Mod browser must be inside the game launcher/menu.
- User communicates in Russian; UI was designed Russian-first with EN toggle.
- Android APK required, preferably signed and downloadable.

## Decisions
- Built as a static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS app compatible with the OMGithub `start.sh` static server.
- No copyrighted Undertale assets used; game is an original short pixel prologue (“THE SEAM”) with original art, dialogue, and chiptune.
- UI defaults to Russian, English toggle included; bundled OFL fonts supporting Cyrillic (`Pixelify Sans`) and Latin pixel font (`Press Start 2P`).
- Mod browser uses live GameBanana API (`Game/5506/Subfeed`, `Mod/{id}/ProfilePage`, `Mod/{id}/Files`) with curated real-mod fallback catalog.
- Mod installs fetch files from GameBanana into IndexedDB; ZIPs are unpacked client-side with vendored JSZip to locate `data.win`/`.win`/patch files.
- Active `data.win` mods apply a deterministic visual palette/profile to the original demo prologue; UI explains this honestly.
- Classic scripts (not ES modules) chosen so Android `file:///android_asset/www/index.html` works.
- Android APK will be built manually with `aapt2`, `javac`, `d8`, `zipalign`, `apksigner` using available Android SDK at `/usr/local/lib/android/sdk`; no Gradle dependency.
- APK will be a WebView wrapper with `INTERNET`, `SoulLinkAndroid` UA, back-button bridge, fullscreen, and local assets.
- Build a debug-signed sideload APK and place it at `download/soul-link-launcher.apk`; link from home/settings.

## Work State
### Completed
- Repository inspected; no existing app code, only OMGithub scaffolding.
- GameBanana API confirmed working with CORS (`access-control-allow-origin: *`); game ID is `5506`; download URLs redirect to CORS-enabled CDN.
- Bundled assets: `vendor/jszip.min.js`, `vendor/JSZIP-LICENSE.md`, fonts and OFL licenses.
- `index.html` created with all four views, SVG pixel icons, modals, toasts, home rail, game HUD/controls, settings, mod browser.
- `styles.css` created with full pixel/CRT design, responsive layout, game styling, mods/settings/modal/toast styles, mobile control layouts.
- `js/i18n.js` created with RU/EN dictionaries and language persistence.
- `js/data.js` created with 12 curated real GameBanana fallback mods, category labels, 8 palettes, RU/EN dialogue, default settings.
- `js/audio.js` created with original WebAudio chiptune loop and UI/game SFX.
- `js/store.js` created with localStorage settings/mod metadata, IndexedDB blobs, mod activation/theme handling, formatting helpers, `data.win` signature inspection.
- `js/game.js` created with playable 480×320 original canvas prologue: exploration, 3 petals, NPC, save star, moving hazards, 15-second bullet-hell echo battle, gate completion, pause/death/complete overlays, mobile/keyboard input.
- `js/mods.js` created with GameBanana feed/detail/files fetch, search/filter/sort/load-more, mod detail modal, download progress, ZIP extraction, local import, install/delete/export, demo theme, installed list.
- `js/app.js` created with boot flow, routing, keyboard/touch input, settings wiring, mods wiring, ambient canvas, modal/toast system, fullscreen, APK detection, language/theme events.

### Active
- First browser verification and debugging not yet performed.
- Known likely issues to fix:
  - `index.html` references missing `assets/icon.svg`, `assets/icon-192.png`, `manifest.webmanifest`.
  - `.thumb-fallback` may cover mod images in cards/modal; needs z-index/visibility fix.
  - Game `setPrompt('')` returns early on fresh state and may leave old prompt visible.
  - `afterIntro()` shows `Эхо-лепесток 0/3` toast; should be a hint instead.
  - Hiding battle banner on death is missing.
  - `installBlob()` checks max size before ZIP extraction but not extracted `data.win`.
  - `mods.refreshLanguage()` has a nonfunctional/open-detail re-render branch.
  - APK label text says “4.2 MB”; actual size should be used or wording changed.
  - `color-mix()` in `.installed-thumb` may be incompatible with older WebViews; replace with fallback.
  - `100dvh` usages need `100vh` fallbacks for older Android WebViews.
  - `#mod-file-input` accepts `.apk` but local installer rejects it; remove `.apk` accept.
- Android APK build not started.
- README not updated.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Create `assets/icon.svg`, `assets/icon-192.png`, `assets/icon-512.png`, `manifest.webmanifest`; update APK size wording.
2. Run `bash start.sh` (or `node "${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs"`) and verify with `playwright-cli` at `http://localhost:3000`; inspect screenshots.
3. Fix runtime/visual bugs found, especially fallback image layering, mobile layout, menu/game routing, GameBanana fetch from `http://localhost` and `file://`.
4. Build Android wrapper under `android/` (manifest, `MainActivity.java`, res, icon, build script) and produce `download/soul-link-launcher.apk`; verify with `aapt dump badging` and `apksigner verify`.
5. Add `.github/workflows` APK build if useful; update `README.md` with controls, mod formats, GameBanana attribution, APK install instructions.
6. Test Android assets via `file://` path implications and confirm local storage/IndexedDB/CORS fallback.
7. Capture final screenshots and report in Russian.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/Undertalelauncher/Undertalelauncher/index.html`: full app markup, views, icons, game UI, mods/settings.
- `/home/runner/work/Undertalelauncher/Undertalelauncher/styles.css`: all layout/design/responsive/game styles.
- `/home/runner/work/Undertalelauncher/Undertalelauncher/js/app.js`: boot, routing, input, settings, modals, ambient, APK detection.
- `/home/runner/work/Undertalelauncher/Undertalelauncher/js/mods.js`: GameBanana API, download/ZIP install, mod browser, library.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate SOUL LINK pixel-art icons (PNG) without external libraries."""
import os
import struct
import zlib

HEART = [
    "..####..####..",
    ".######.######.",
    "##############",
    "##############",
    "##############",
    ".############.",
    "..##########..",
    "...########...",
    "....######....",
    ".....####.....",
    "......##......",
]

BG = (11, 7, 20, 255)
BG2 = (17, 11, 30, 255)
BORDER = (58, 41, 84, 255)
RED = (255, 51, 85, 255)
RED_DARK = (179, 0, 47, 255)
GOLD = (255, 215, 94, 255)
WHITE = (255, 244, 214, 255)


def blank(size, color=(0, 0, 0, 0)):
    return [[color for _ in range(size)] for _ in range(size)]


def put(img, x, y, color):
    if 0 <= y < len(img) and 0 <= x < len(img[y]):
        img[y][x] = color


def rect(img, x, y, w, h, color):
    for yy in range(y, y + h):
        for xx in range(x, x + w):
            put(img, xx, yy, color)


def make_icon(size, transparent=False):
    img = blank(size)
    if not transparent:
        rect(img, 0, 0, size, size, BG)
        cell = max(4, size // 32)
        for y in range(0, size, cell):
            for x in range(0, size, cell):
                if (x // cell + y // cell) % 2 == 0:
                    rect(img, x, y, cell, cell, BG2)
        b = max(3, size // 64)
        rect(img, 0, 0, size, b, BORDER)
        rect(img, 0, size - b, size, b, BORDER)
        rect(img, 0, 0, b, size, BORDER)
        rect(img, size - b, 0, b, size, BORDER)
        # corner cuts for a pixel feel
        c = size // 16
        for i in range(c):
            for j in range(c - i):
                put(img, i, j, (0, 0, 0, 0))
                put(img, size - 1 - i, j, (0, 0, 0, 0))
                put(img, i, size - 1 - j, (0, 0, 0, 0))
                put(img, size - 1 - i, size - 1 - j, (0, 0, 0, 0))

    # heart 14 columns x 11 rows, scaled and centred
    cols = len(HEART[0])
    rows = len(HEART)
    scale = int(size * (0.62 if transparent else 0.56) / max(cols, rows))
    scale = max(1, scale)
    hw = cols * scale
    hh = rows * scale
    ox = (size - hw) // 2
    oy = (size - hh) // 2
    for ry, line in enumerate(HEART):
        for rx, ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch != '#':
                continue
            color = RED
            if ry >= rows - 3 and rx >= 4 + (ry - (rows - 3)):
                color = RED_DARK
            rect(img, ox + rx * scale, oy + ry * scale, scale, scale, color)
    # highlight
    rect(img, ox + 3 * scale, oy + 2 * scale, scale, scale, WHITE)
    # gold spark
    if size >= 48:
        s = max(1, scale // 2)
        sx = ox + hw + scale * 2
        sy = oy - scale * 2
        rect(img, sx, sy + s, s, s, GOLD)
        rect(img, sx - s, sy + 2 * s, s * 3, s, GOLD)
        rect(img, sx, sy + 3 * s, s, s, GOLD)
    return img


def write_png(path, img):
    size = len(img)
    raw = b"".join(b"\x00" + bytes(v for px in row for v in px) for row in img)

    def chunk(tag, data):
        return (
            struct.pack(">I", len(data))
            + tag
            + data
            + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(tag + data) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
        )

    png = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
    png += chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", size, size, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0))
    png += chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw, 9))
    png += chunk(b"IEND", b"")
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(png)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
    write_png(os.path.join(root, "assets", "icon-192.png"), make_icon(192))
    write_png(os.path.join(root, "assets", "icon-512.png"), make_icon(512))
    write_png(os.path.join(root, "assets", "icon-maskable-512.png"), make_icon(512))

    android_res = os.path.join(root, "android", "app", "src", "main", "res")
    sizes = {
        "mipmap-mdpi": 48,
        "mipmap-hdpi": 72,
        "mipmap-xhdpi": 96,
        "mipmap-xxhdpi": 144,
        "mipmap-xxxhdpi": 192,
    }
    for folder, px in sizes.items():
        write_png(os.path.join(android_res, folder, "ic_launcher.png"), make_icon(px))
        write_png(
            os.path.join(android_res, folder, "ic_launcher_foreground.png"),
            make_icon(px, transparent=True),
        )
    print("icons written")

## Objective
- Build an original Undertale-style launcher web app with mobile pixel controls, community mod support (`data.win`, ZIP, `.xdelta`), an in-game mod browser (main menu: New Game, Settings, Mods) integrated with GameBanana.
- Provide a downloadable Android APK (“И ещё на андроид АПК”).

## Requirements
- Main menu must contain exactly: New Game, Settings, Mods.
- Mobile controls in pixel style, usable on Android.
- Mods must support `data.win` or other community formats and be downloadable from GameBanana.
- Mod browser must live inside the game launcher/menu.
- User communicates in Russian; UI designed Russian-first with EN toggle.
- Android APK required, preferably signed and directly downloadable.

## Decisions
- Static HTML/CSS/vanilla JS app compatible with the OMGithub `start.sh` static server.
- No copyrighted Undertale assets: original short pixel prologue “THE SEAM” with original art, dialogue, and chiptune.
- RU default regardless of browser locale; EN toggle persisted in localStorage.
- Bundled OFL fonts: `Pixelify Sans` (Cyrillic) and `Press Start 2P`.
- Mod browser uses live GameBanana API (`Game/5506/Subfeed`, `Mod/{id}/ProfilePage`, `Mod/{id}/Files`) with 12 curated real-mod fallback records.
- ZIPs unpacked client-side with vendored JSZip to locate `data.win`/`.win`/patch files.
- Active `data.win` mods apply a deterministic visual palette/profile to the original demo prologue; UI states this honestly.
- Classic scripts only; Android wrapper uses a custom `https://app.soullink.local/` origin intercepting assets so localStorage/IndexedDB/CORS work normally.
- APK built without Gradle using `aapt2`, `javac`, `d8`, `zipalign`, `apksigner`; package `com.soullink.undertalelauncher`, label `SOUL LINK`, minSdk 23, targetSdk 35.
- Debug-signed sideload APK at `download/soul-link-launcher.apk`, linked from home/settings.
- Web assets generated/copied into Android `assets/www` at build time.

## Work State
### Completed
- Core app implemented: `index.html`, `styles.css`, `js/i18n.js`, `js/data.js`, `js/audio.js`, `js/store.js`, `js/game.js`, `js/mods.js`, `js/app.js`.
- Original 480×320 canvas prologue with exploration, 3 petals, NPC, save star, hazards, 15-second bullet-hell echo battle, gate, pause/death/complete overlays, keyboard/touch input.
- GameBanana live feed confirmed working (`live=true`, `total=534`, RU status “GameBanana подключён”).
- Mod detail modal verified: real thumbnails, description, screenshots, 3 files for SOULGRIND.
- Added `assets/icon.svg`, `assets/icon-192.png`, `assets/icon-512.png`, `assets/icon-maskable-512.png`, `manifest.webmanifest`.
- Icon generator `tools/make-icons.py` also produces Android mipmap PNGs.
- Fixed horizontal overflow on mobile by constraining grid tracks/min-widths; verified `scrollWidth` ~390 at 390px.
- Fixed featured card mobile overlap by resetting `height:auto` on `.featured-media`.
- Fixed thumbnail fallback layering with `has-image` / `is-broken` states.
- Fixed `setPrompt` early return, removed erroneous petal-0 toast, hide battle banner on death, post-ZIP size check, language refresh for open detail modal, `.apk` accept removal, `color-mix` removal, `dvh` fallbacks, APK size wording.
- Android source started: manifest, `MainActivity` package structure pending, resources (`strings.xml`, `colors.xml`, `styles.xml`, values-v31, adaptive icon), mipmap icons generated.
- Browser screenshots verified for desktop home, mobile home, mobile mods grid, mobile mod detail.

### Active
- Android `MainActivity.java`, build script, and APK assembly not yet completed.
- Mod file installation is broken due to CORS redirect failure.
- Export/import bridge and back-button bridge for Android not yet implemented.

### Blocked
- GameBanana file download fails: `https://gamebanana.com/dl/{id}` → `files.gamebanana.com` 302 lacks `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, so Chromium rejects redirect before final `filecache*.gamebanana.com` response (which does send ACAO `*`).

# SOUL LINK — Undertale Launcher

Неофициальный карманный лаунчер в стиле UNDERTALE: оригинальный пиксельный пролог,
мобильное управление и встроенный браузер модов GameBanana.

> Это фанатский проект. UNDERTALE © Toby Fox. Игра не содержит оригинальных
> ассетов, музыки или текстов UNDERTALE. Моды принадлежат их авторам, а каталог
> загружается через публичный API GameBanana.

## Что внутри

- **Главное меню ровно из трёх пунктов:** `Новая игра`, `Настройки`, `Моды`.
- **Оригинальный пролог «THE SEAM»** — короткое приключение на canvas 480×320:
  исследование, три лепестка, NPC, звезда сохранения, опасности, 15-секундная
  битва с эхом и финальные врата.
- **Пиксельное мобильное управление**: D-pad и кнопки `A` / `B`, увеличенные зоны
  нажатия, вибро-отклик, настройки левши и постоянного показа контролов.
- **Mod browser прямо в лаунчере**: живой каталог GameBanana (Undertale, game id
  `5506`), поиск, категории, сортировка, карточки модов, скриншоты, файлы и
  установка в один тап.
- **Форматы сообщества**: `data.win`, ZIP-архивы с `data.win` / `game.win` внутри,
  а также `.xdelta`, `.patch`, `.bps`. ZIP распаковывается прямо в браузере.
- **Локальная библиотека**: установленные моды хранятся в IndexedDB, можно
  включать/выключать, экспортировать и удалять.
- **RU / EN**, русский интерфейс по умолчанию. Выбор языка запоминается.
- **Android APK** с полноэкранным WebView, нативной загрузкой модов и кнопкой
  «Назад».

## Быстрый запуск (web)

```bash
# любой статический сервер из корня проекта
python3 -m http.server 3000
# открыть http://localhost:3000
```

На OMGithub используется `start.sh`. Приложение полностью статическое: HTML, CSS,
vanilla JS, вендорный JSZip и локальные OFL-шрифты.

## Управление

| Действие | Клавиатура | Телефон |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Движение | `← ↑ → ↓` / `WASD` | D-pad |
| Действие / подтвердить | `Z`, `Enter`, `Space` | `A` |
| Отмена / назад | `X`, `Esc`, `Backspace` | `B` |
| Моды | `M` | меню → «Моды» |
| Настройки | `S` | меню → «Настройки» |
| Новая игра | `N` | меню → «Новая игра» |
| Полный экран | `F` | кнопка в шапке |

На Android системная кнопка «Назад» закрывает модальное окно, затем возвращает в
главное меню, а на главном экране выходит из приложения.

## Моды и GameBanana

- Каталог: `https://gamebanana.com/apiv11/Game/5506/Subfeed`.
- Детали и файлы: `Mod/{id}/ProfilePage`, `Mod/{id}/Files`.
- Если API недоступен, показывается кэшированный набор реальных модов.
- **Web:** прямая загрузка с GameBanana блокируется CORS на промежуточном
  редиректе `files.gamebanana.com`. Приложение сначала пробует прямой запрос,
  затем публичный CORS-прокси. Если оба способа недоступны, показываются кнопки
  «Открыть на GameBanana» и «Импортировать файл».
- **Android:** файл скачивается нативно через `HttpURLConnection` (без CORS),
  кладётся в кэш приложения и отдаётся WebView по локальному адресу
  `https://app.soullink.local/__cache__/…`. Поэтому установка из каталога
  работает без прокси.

### Что именно применяется

`data.win` проверяется по сигнатуре `FORM` + `GEN8`. Активный мод определяет
детерминированную цветовую палитру и визуальный профиль оригинального пролога.
Лаунчер **не исполняет** GameMaker-байткод и не запускает полноценную UNDERTALE:
это честная демонстрация интеграции модов, а не эмулятор игры. Патчи
`.xdelta`/`.bps` сохраняются в библиотеке как файлы сообщества.

## Android APK

Готовая debug-подписанная сборка:

```
download/soul-link-launcher.apk
```

- Package: `com.soullink.undertalelauncher`
- Label: `SOUL LINK`
- minSdk 23 (Android 6.0), targetSdk 35
- Разрешения: интернет, состояние сети, запись в хранилище только до Android 9.

Установка: скачать APK на телефон → разрешить установку из неизвестных источников
→ открыть файл. Это debug-подпись для сайдлоада, не для Google Play.

### Сборка APK без Gradle

Нужны Android SDK, build-tools и JDK:

```bash
ANDROID_HOME=/path/to/android-sdk bash tools/build-apk.sh
```

Скрипт сам копирует веб-ассеты в `android/app/src/main/assets/www`, собирает
ресурсы через `aapt2`, компилирует Java, делает dex через `d8`, выравнивает
`zipalign` и подписывает `apksigner`. Keystore лежит в
`android/keystore/soullink-debug.jks` (пароль `soullink`), чтобы обновления
ставились поверх предыдущей версии.

Иконки пересоздаются командой:

```bash
python3 tools/make-icons.py
```

## Структура

```
index.html                 разметка, иконки, экраны и модальные окна
styles.css                 дизайн, адаптив, игровые контролы
js/i18n.js                 RU/EN словари
js/data.js                 кэш модов, палитры, диалоги
js/store.js                настройки, IndexedDB, библиотека модов
js/mods.js                 GameBanana API, загрузка, ZIP, установка
js/game.js                 оригинальный пролог «THE SEAM»
js/app.js                  роутинг, ввод, настройки, Android-back
android/                   исходники WebView-обёртки
tools/build-apk.sh         сборка APK без Gradle
tools/make-icons.py        генерация PNG-иконок
vendor/jszip.min.js        распаковка ZIP
download/                  готовый APK
```

## Лицензии

- Шрифты `Pixelify Sans` и `Press Start 2P` — SIL Open Font License, тексты
  лицензий в `assets/fonts/`.
- JSZip — MIT.
- Код лаунчера — фанатский проект; соблюдайте права авторов модов и правообладателей.
